stem: Which characteristic was shared by the darker-shaded states on this map?

options.label: A
options.text: They were states that joined the Confederacy before the firing on Ft. Sumter.

options.label: B
options.text: They were slave states that remained in the Union during the Civil War.

options.label: C
options.text: They were states that voted against declaring war on the Confederacy.

options.label: D
options.text: They were slave states that supported Abraham Lincoln in the 1860 presidential election.

visual_elements: Map of United States, 1861, showing state and territorial borders. Several states are shaded darker.
